note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received on Wednesday 20 April 1927; the Mid-Ulster Mail printed the full list of nominations by division (23 April 1927, p. 5), as did the Northern Whig (21 April 1927, p. 7). Killeenan, with two Nationalist nominations, was the only division polled, on Wednesday 1 June 1927, Tyrone's polling day for county council and rural district elections that year; every other division had one nomination. Labels are as printed. Michael Early was the only nomination for Slatequarry. Returned unopposed.
